title: Kasumi Jūsha
body:
Syntax: perform kasumi juusha <target>

Description: Haze-like illusory warriors that sharply reduce accuracy.  Its haze sharply lowers the victim's accuracy. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 203-235. 75% chance to inflict haze. The effect lasts 24 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 43. Costs 34 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
